expected.baseline: project synthetic Prefetch fixture; SCCA uncompressed and MAM-compressed payloads validated; run_count cross-checked with known execution history; format versions 17, 23, 26, 30 (variants 1/2), 31 all covered

guaranteedFields.name: executable
guaranteedFields.description: executable name from Prefetch header (UTF-16LE, up to 60 bytes); falls back to 'unknown' when unparsable

guaranteedFields.name: run_count
guaranteedFields.description: execution count; offset varies by format version (field offsets documented per version)

guaranteedFields.name: format_version
guaranteedFields.description: Prefetch format version (17, 23, 26, 30, or 31); determines file_info layout

guaranteedFields.name: hash
guaranteedFields.description: Prefetch hash as 8 uppercase hex digits (zero-padded, e.g. "0A1B2C3D")

guaranteedFields.name: file_size
guaranteedFields.description: executable file size in bytes from Prefetch header

guaranteedFields.name: last_run_times
guaranteedFields.description: last execution timestamps; up to 8 entries for v26+; single entry for v17/v23; entries filtered to year range 2001-2099

bestEffortFields.name: volume_serial_number
bestEffortFields.description: volume serial number; offset and presence vary by format version

bestEffortFields.name: device_path
bestEffortFields.description: device path string; parsing coverage varies by format version

bestEffortFields.name: dependency_file_names
bestEffortFields.description: referenced file names; presence and count vary by version and sample

bestEffortFields.name: compression_type
bestEffortFields.description: "SCCA" (uncompressed) or "MAM" (compressed); decompression succeeds on Windows but not on non-Windows

notGuaranteedFields.name: dependency_section_offset
notGuaranteedFields.description: raw offset to dependency section; internal detail not exposed as stable output

notGuaranteedFields.name: raw_mam_payload
notGuaranteedFields.description: undecoded MAM compressed payload; decompression not available on non-Windows platforms

notGuaranteedFields.name: prefetch_directory_timestamp
notGuaranteedFields.description: last modification time of the .pf file itself; not part of parser output, derived from filesystem layer

expected.fieldNamingConvention: camelCase for top-level DTO; snake_case for attrs map keys within artifacts
expected.timezoneNormalizationRule: all FILETIME values converted to UTC via Windows epoch offset (1601-01-01); run_times entries serialized as RFC 3339; timestamps outside year range 2001-2099 are excluded as unreasonable

emptyValueStrategy.null: absent or invalid FILETIME value (zero, max, or out of range)
emptyValueStrategy.emptyString: executable name could not be parsed (defaults to 'unknown')
emptyValueStrategy.zero: valid zero for run_count (should not occur for valid prefetch files)

expected.sortOrderRule: artifacts sorted by executable name ascending (case-insensitive); last_run_times within artifact sorted by timestamp descending
